description: iPhone <-> Apple Watch sync over WatchConnectivity. Phone publishes the account binding, plan and exercise catalog with updateApplicationContext; the watch sends finished workouts with transferUserInfo; the phone answers with ack/nack via transferUserInfo. Source of truth for WatchSyncProtocol (GymAppWatchShared) and its golden tests. iOS only.

states.unbound: Phone signed out or deleting/switching. Only type, protocolVersion, state, sentAtMillis. Watch drops the cached plan and catalog, keeps the outbox, disables Start.
states.bound: accountBinding, language, planRevision required; plan (array, may be empty = no plan) and exercises (array) required.

context.exercises: Free-workout picker catalog: unique trimmed names, plan names first, then library names (GarminPhoneSyncProtocol.exerciseCatalog without Latin conversion).
context.restEndAlert: Optional, bound only, JSON boolean. The phone's device-local Settings switch "Rest end alert" (default on). Absent means true; the phone sends it only as false, so the default context keeps its exact earlier key set. false: the watch plays no rest-end haptic and schedules no rest-end notification; the rest countdown still runs and ends. A non-boolean value (for example 0) makes the context invalid. Always taken from the incoming context (also when the cached plan is kept). Watch builds without this field reject a context that carries it and keep their cached context.

rules: endedAtMillis > startedAtMillis; startedAtMillis >= minimumStartedAtMillis; endedAtMillis <= receiver now + maximumFutureSkewMillis.
Every completedAtMillis lies in [startedAtMillis - setTimeToleranceMillis, endedAtMillis + setTimeToleranceMillis].
averageHeartRate and maximumHeartRate are both present or both absent; average <= maximum.
planRevision is present only when mode is plan.
Names: trimmed, non-empty, no Unicode Cc, <= maximumExerciseCharacters scalars and maximumExerciseBytes UTF-8; total name bytes <= maximumTotalExerciseBytes.
Phone -> watch, sent only when an account or local profile is deleted (never on sign-out or account switch), in addition to the unchanged unbound context. The context keeps its exact v1 key set.

accountBinding is the deleted account's binding. The phone records it durably before clearing the account's watch data and sends it once WatchConnectivity is active with a paired watch that has the app (also after startup recovery of an interrupted deletion).
Watch: exact keys for protocolVersion 1; from a newer phone only accountBinding is read. Watches without this message ignore it (unknown userInfo type).

watchOutboxRules: An outbox item is deleted only after an ack whose requestId and accountBinding match the item.
transient: keep the item queued and retry with backoff 60, 300, 900, 3600 s (cap 3600) and on every new bound context.

hold: keep the item and do not send it until a context arrives whose accountBinding equals the item's (foreign-account) or whose protocolVersion is greater than the last one seen (unsupported-version).
deterministic: keep the item, mark it failed and show it under Unsent workouts; only an explicit user Discard (with a confirmation step) deletes it.
Items are sent only while the latest context is bound to the item's accountBinding.
The item stores the exact encoded envelope; resends are byte-identical so the phone digest matches.

account-deleted: delete every outbox item whose accountBinding equals the message's, whatever its status; silently discard a live or summary workout of that binding (no Health save); a workout being saved for that binding has its item dropped when the save settles. Items and workouts of other bindings are kept.
phoneRules: Decision order: envelope bytes/JSON/shape -> protocolVersion -> ready account -> accountBinding -> ledger(requestId) -> rate limit -> write.
Envelope over maximumEnvelopeBytes, not JSON, or without a valid requestId: drop silently (cannot correlate).
Otherwise malformed shape or bounds: nack malformed, no ledger or store write.
protocolVersion greater than supported: nack unsupported-version.
No signed-in account, store not bound or account transition in progress: nack not-ready.
accountBinding differs from the active account's binding: nack foreign-account; nothing is written (no ledger, no workout).

requestId already committed with the same digest: ack duplicate, no write. Pending with the same digest: verify the workout exists, then commit and ack; if missing, drop the pending record and import again.
requestId known with a different digest: nack conflict.
More than maximumReceiptsPerHour receipts in the last hour: nack rate-limited.

Write the pending receipt durably before the store write; ack only after the workout is stored and the receipt is committed durably. Store validation error -> nack invalid; persistence error -> nack storage.

Sets present -> WorkoutStore.createWorkout(date:note:namedSets:durationSeconds:); no sets (time-only) -> createActivityWorkout(date:note:durationSeconds:), stored as an activity-only workout with its explicit metrics (duration, calories, heart rate).

The import never skips a valid watch workout because another workout overlaps it. In the same write, a watch workout replaces an overlapping Health-imported workout: one that is activity-only, carries a Health import receipt for its start, whose note still starts with the Health import note prefix, and that overlaps the watch workout by the Health import overlap rule (overlapToleranceSeconds). That workout and its activity sidecar are removed; the Health import receipt stays so the import never brings it back. A user-edited note (prefix gone) or a non-overlapping workout is kept. Both clients apply this to Garmin and Wear OS / Apple Watch workouts.

accountBinding.local: random sha256hex stored per account storage key (defaults key watch-phone-local-account.v1.<sha256hex(storageKey)>)
